dedupe_keys.name: 水道統計 japan water supply statistics jwwa free overview extracts for recent years and the facilities and operations edition with a search system

description: The Japan Water Works Association compiles Water Statistics, the national yearbook of Japan's water utilities, from a survey of every utility carried out each fiscal year through the health ministry and prefectural water departments. The extract page read on 2026-09-28 publishes the statistical overview for fiscal years 2021 to 2023 as PDFs, and a guide explains the full edition: the facilities and operations volume, sold as a book with a CD-ROM, holds about 4,000 items per utility on business plans, coverage, facilities and supply, and the water quality volume on DVD-ROM about 3,000 items; utility data have been electronic since fiscal 2001, and since fiscal 2015 the CD-ROM carries a search system for querying, aggregating and computing performance indicators. Coverage is all Japanese water utilities. The overview PDFs are free; the full editions are JWWA publications for purchase, at prices not read, and no data licence was read. Caveats: the FY2023 overview is a 92-page image-based PDF without a text layer. It supports water supply capacity and resilience studies, such as comparing utilities' pipe length, reservoir storage and earthquake-resistant pipe shares when planning seismic upgrades. Related record: the JWWA tap water quality database.
